caption: The worked example as one chain: 10 KLOC gives 26.9 person-months, then 8.7 months, 3.1 people and ₹21.5 lakh. The sized input sits at the top and the money answer at the bottom; every box in between is produced by the one above it.

spec.title: Organic COCOMO, 10 KLOC
spec.aria: A five-step chain: 10 KLOC sized part by part gives effort 26.9 person-months by E = 2.4 x KLOC^1.05, then duration 8.7 months, then average staff 3.1 people by E divided by D, then cost about 21.5 lakh rupees at 80,000 rupees per person-month.
